reads this file, then verifies every declaration against the world — a URL
here is fetched, not trusted — and exits non-zero while anything is
outstanding. Writing a value in here does not make G12 pass; it tells the
PRD §23 beat 4 ends with a witnessed trader claiming the bond. That is now
exactly what happened (DECISIONS.md D-047), so the beat is performable as
written. What the video must still say out loud is the limitation §23 names
with it: a payout reaches traders the chain saw trading inside the window,
and nobody else. Declare the words used; the gate checks they are present.
demo.beat4LimitationStatement: A witnessed trader claimed the whole bond, and the transaction is on chain. But a payout only ever reaches traders the registry saw filling inside the window — it learns that from the pool's own logs. If you held the position and lost money without trading in that window, this pays you nothing.
